SELECT ab.benefit_no AS benefitNo, b.plcy_nm AS plcyNm, bc.category_name AS categoryName, b.apply_end_date AS applyEndDate, ab.applied_at AS appliedAt
FROM applied_benefit ab JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_no = ab.benefit_no JOIN benefit_category bc ON bc.category_code = b.category_code
WHERE ab.member_no = #{memberNo}
ORDER BY ab.applied_at DESC, ab.applied_no DESC
